title: Translate the Safety Notice into Japanese
context: RideBelt is an open, safety-critical Hee-Lee Oss project: an optional rider-worn backup restraint (low hip belt + short tethers; optional clip-on Shoulder Module or one-piece Integrated Harness) that latches into an open seat anchor standard (RAS). ALL safety content is DRAFT and not for use until a credentialed engineer signs off at the MVP gate (GOVERNANCE.md). Never remove a DRAFT banner, never give instructions for wearing or attaching anything to a ride, never copy text from paid standards (cite by number and title only), never name private individuals or incident victims, and respect the patent design-arounds in docs/research/patentability-fto.md. The Safety Notice is the most important page for non-English visitors: it says the designs are DRAFT and must not be built, worn or attached to rides.
objective: Translate SAFETY-NOTICE.md into Japanese, keeping meaning exact and the tone firm.
acceptanceCriteria: Meaning matches the English exactly; nothing softened
Translator notes any terms with no direct equivalent
Marked as needing native-speaker review before merge
